tasks.label: Clean
tasks.command: if (Test-Path 'sim/sim.out') { Remove-Item 'sim/sim.out' -Force }; if (Test-Path 'sim/wave.vcd') { Remove-Item 'sim/wave.vcd' -Force }; if (Test-Path 'sim/test_vectors.txt') { Remove-Item 'sim/test_vectors.txt' -Force }

tasks.label: Compile & Run
tasks.command: iverilog -o sim/sim.out src/*.v tb/*.v; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { chcp 65001 > $null; vvp sim/sim.out }
